integrity: Unrestricted proof uses Dirichlet reciprocal-prime divergence, Hensel lifting, CRT, and multiplicativity. Computer checks are finite regression only. Focal conjecture and earlier heuristic credited to their published authors. The exact question was publicly asked in 2020; its classified 2022 preprint has primary MSC 11A05.
scientific_limitations: No quantitative rate, no pointwise divergence, and no independence or finiteness statement about odd perfect numbers. Fixed-prime and fixed-exponent density assertions are not uniform when these parameters grow.
title: Density-zero gcd equality and divergence of the square-divisor gcd ratio
